units.source_text: 男人抑制不住渐渐涌起来的兴奋。

en.t: The man could not hold back the excitement that was gradually welling up inside him.

units.source_text: 想了半天，答案只有一个，那就是“毛细管现象”。

en.t: After thinking it over for a long time, there was only one answer: capillary action.

units.source_text: 沙子的表面比热较高，所以一直是干燥的，

en.t: Because the surface of the sand had a high specific heat, it was always dry,

units.source_text: 可往下一挖，下面一定是潮湿的。

en.t: but if one dug down into it, the layer beneath was sure to be damp.

units.source_text: 表面的蒸发起了水泵的作用，把地下的水分吸了上来。

en.t: Evaporation at the surface acted like a pump, drawing moisture up from underground.

units.source_text: 这么一想，就很容易理解为什么早晨、傍晚沙丘会吐出那么大量的雾气，

en.t: Thinking of it this way made it easy to understand why the dunes breathed out such enormous amounts of mist in the morning and evening,

units.source_text: 为什么板壁和柱子沾了沙子，异常的湿度会导致木材腐烂。

en.t: and why, when sand clung to the plank walls and posts, the abnormal humidity caused the wood to rot.

units.source_text: 原来沙地上的干燥，并不仅仅因为缺水，

en.t: So the dryness of sandy ground was not simply due to a lack of water,

units.source_text: 倒像是因为“毛细管现象”的吸引，远远赶不上蒸发的速度所致。

en.t: but rather because the pull of capillary action fell far behind the speed of evaporation.

units.source_text: 换言之，水的补充是源源不断的。

en.t: In other words, the supply of water was continuous.

units.source_text: 只是那种循环的速度是一般土地所无法想象的。

en.t: It was just that the speed of that cycle was unimaginable in ordinary soil.

units.source_text: 而他的“希望”，恰巧在某个地方截断了这种循环。

en.t: And his Hope had happened to interrupt that cycle at some point.

units.source_text: 这恐怕与埋桶的位置，盖子的缝隙等都有关系，

en.t: This probably had something to do with the position of the buried bucket, the gaps in the lid, and such things,

units.source_text: 偶然吸上来的水没有蒸发掉，正好流进桶里。

en.t: so that water drawn up by chance did not evaporate, but flowed neatly into the bucket.

units.source_text: 到底是怎样一种位置和关系，现在虽然还不能清楚地说明，

en.t: Although he still could not clearly explain exactly what kind of position and relationship it was,

units.source_text: 但只要好好地研究，一定能够再重复一次。

en.t: if he studied it carefully, he would certainly be able to reproduce it.

units.source_text: 说不定还能设计出效率更高的蓄水装置。

en.t: He might even be able to design a more efficient water storage device.
